I couldn't get an answer: the clp MCP server refused every search, so I have no NOTICE count and no messages to report.

1. `mcp__clp__get_instructions` worked and returned the CKQL usage guide.
2. `mcp__clp__search_by_kql` with `error_severity: NOTICE` then failed with:
   `{"Error":"Please call `get_instructions()` first to understand how to use this MCP server."}`
3. I called `get_instructions` again (it worked again) and retried the same search. Same error.
4. A plain `*` search also returned the same error.

The server never seems to remember that `get_instructions` was called. My guess is that it doesn't keep its state between tool calls, for example because each call opens a new session. That is a guess; the tool results don't show the cause.

To fix it, check how the clp MCP server keeps track of sessions (its transport setting, or whether it runs statelessly), or restart it. Then I can run the query again.
